item.title: LL Cool J Recalls Hearing That Ol’ Dirty Bastard Urinated on His Plaques: ‘Loved Him Ever Since’
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "You won't believe the crazy story LL Cool J just shared about the late Ol' Dirty Bastard. The hip-hop legend recently sat down with SiriusXM's Salute the Sample and recalled a wild incident that happened at a New York City studio."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Apparently, Ol' Dirty Bastard showed up at Chung King Studios, broke LL Cool J's plaques, and... wait for it... urinated on them. Yes, you heard that right. LL Cool J got a call from Chris Lighty, telling him to come down to the studio because ODB had lost it."
[Short music transition]
Host: "But here's the crazy part: instead of being angry, LL Cool J just laughed it off. He said, 'I didn't even understand it, I couldn't understand it. Loved him ever since.' The incident actually added to their friendship, and LL Cool J still looks back on it fondly."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Chris Lighty, the late music executive, also shared his side of the story in a 2006 interview. He said ODB showed up 'twisted' and started ripping plaques off the wall, even pissing on one of them. But in a bizarre twist, ODB changed his tune at the bottom of the elevator and started laughing hysterically."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Ol' Dirty Bastard may be gone, but his legacy lives on. And LL Cool J is keeping the spirit of hip-hop alive with his upcoming Rock the Bells Festival, happening on August 15th in Long Island. We can't wait to see the lineup and celebrate the music that brings us all together."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today, folks. Thanks for tuning in to this wild story about Ol' Dirty Bastard and LL Cool J. Until next time, keep it locked to our podcast for more hip-hop history and behind-the-scenes stories."
